title: Field
description: A FieldDef once it has been filled. Flat with a discriminator: kind decides which value slot is meaningful, the rest are null.

tool_id.description: Set only when the value arrived from a paired instrument. Its presence is what makes the class measured.

provenance_class.description: Stamped by the Seal from the acceptance rule and the capture surface. Never asserted by a model. Null until sealed.

resolved_from_order.description: Which resolution step supplied the bound. See data-model.md section 5.

resolved_from_cite.description: doc/section/page when the order is spec.

component_ref.description: Evidence attaches to the component, not the position, so it survives the part moving machines.
